mechanism_summary: Service customs-docs/manifest-renderer selects app=manifest-render while the manifest-renderer pods carry the label app=manifest-renderer, so the selector matches no pod and the Service's Endpoints object is empty; the manifest submitter's rendering calls to the Service have nowhere to go although both renderer pods are Running and Ready.
decisive_evidence: Endpoints customs-docs/manifest-renderer with no addresses; service manifest-renderer spec.selector {app: manifest-render} against pod labels app=manifest-renderer on two Ready pods (the Deployment's own selector is app=manifest-renderer and matches); manifest-submitter log lines 'renderer http://manifest-renderer.customs-docs.svc:8080/health UNREACHABLE after 3s; filing request failed, load held at border' with no Warning events anywhere in the namespace.
remediation_summary: Set spec.selector.app on service customs-docs/manifest-renderer to manifest-renderer (kubectl patch service manifest-renderer -n customs-docs -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"manifest-renderer"}}}'); Endpoints fill with the two renderer pods within seconds and the submitter's next attempt logs 'renderer OK', with no change to either Deployment.
